profile.name: Sanskruti Udage
profile.tagline: Turning data into decisions — and shipping the product around them.
profile.role: Software Developer · Data-Driven Product Builder · AI/ML
profile.status: B.Tech CSE (AI & ML), VIT Bhopal — Expected Jan 2027
profile.bio: I'm a final-year CSE (AI & ML) undergraduate at VIT Bhopal (CGPA 8.08) who likes owning a problem end-to-end — from the data pipeline to the interface someone actually clicks on. My flagship build, PitWall, pairs a live F1 telemetry dashboard with a win-probability model and a strategy recommender that turns raw data into a clear call. I've also built a RAG-based video intelligence chatbot on LangGraph and ChromaDB. Comfortable across the stack — pipelines, backend services, frontend, and the metrics that tell you whether any of it worked — and currently looking for software development and AI/ML engineering roles.

experience.summary: Built an inventory tracking system for a manufacturing supply chain unit.
highlights: Built an inventory tracking system in Python for a manufacturing supply chain unit, enabling real-time visibility into stock levels and reorder points.
Applied ML for demand forecasting and generative AI for automated reporting, streamlining inventory tracking and cutting manual effort for the unit.

experience.summary: Built and shipped ML models end-to-end, from feature engineering to production monitoring.
highlights: Improved model prediction accuracy through systematic feature engineering and hyperparameter tuning across TensorFlow and scikit-learn models, using NumPy and Pandas for preprocessing.
Deployed and monitored end-to-end ML pipelines from data ingestion through production, using Git for version control and reproducibility.

projects.title: RAG Video Intelligence Chatbot
projects.subtitle: Semantic search over YouTube & Reels, with citations
projects.description: An automated pipeline transcribes YouTube and Instagram Reel audio with OpenAI Whisper and stores embedded chunks in ChromaDB for semantic search. A LangGraph-orchestrated FastAPI backend delivers citation-grounded, multi-turn answers with conversation memory, streamed token-by-token to a React frontend.

projects.title: PitWall
projects.subtitle: Live F1 Race Intelligence Dashboard
projects.description: A full-stack live telemetry dashboard polling the OpenF1 API every 5 seconds for lap times, positions, tyre compounds, pit stops, and weather, with a Python + FastF1 ETL pipeline as historical fallback. Ships a 10-panel dashboard: a PIT NOW / STAY OUT strategy recommender, a 6-feature ML win-probability model, driver comparison, telemetry bars, and a race replay scrubber — plus an AI race engineer chatbot on Groq Llama 3.3-70B behind a secure serverless proxy.

projects.title: Pneumonia Detection from X-rays
projects.subtitle: ResNet-50 CNN for chest X-ray classification
projects.description: Trained a ResNet-50 CNN to classify pneumonia in chest X-rays, reaching a 92% F1-score on test data. Preprocessed DICOM medical images in OpenCV and cut false positives by 15% through targeted augmentation.
